reading: Art crime investigators and security experts say burglaries from galleries across Europe are becoming more brazen.
When thieves broke into a French museum earlier this week and stole four paintings by Pierre-Auguste Renoir, not everyone was surprised.
The European policing agency (Europol) had warned that museum thefts across Europe were growing increasingly brazen just last month.
Internationally known art detective Arthur Brand predicted that more high-profile burglaries were likely after a successful robbery at the Louvre in Paris.
The audacious crime at the Louvre stunned France, and the stolen jewellery worth €88m has still not been recovered.
Museums are vulnerable and easy to burgle, Brand says, compared with well-secured jewellery shops and banks.
Directors historically "never have enough money for security" or prefer to spend it on the next exhibition.
Many of these burglaries are over in minutes and the thieves have long gone by the time police show up.
Now precious metals, gemstones, and culturally significant artefacts are increasingly targeted, according to Europol's report.
Precious metals can be easily melted down, leaving no trace for law enforcement, and facilitating illicit sales during the fencing process.
Christopher A Marinello, the boss of Art Recovery International, says only 5-10% of stolen art is ever recovered.
Experts say the trick is to create physical barriers that will delay thieves so there is time for the police to arrive or deter would-be offenders.
However, security measures are expensive, and finding the money is a main challenge for smaller cities with important collections.
A museum cannot be a fortress, but institutions are facing new challenges that will require new security standards.

vocabulary.definition: done in a very open and shocking way, without caring if people are shocked.
crimes where someone illegally enters a building to steal things.
showing a willingness to take surprisingly bold risks, often in a shocking or rude way.
extremely surprised or shocked by something.
found again after being lost or stolen.
chosen or aimed at for a particular action.
not allowed by laws or rules; illegal.
to make someone decide not to do something, especially by making them feel afraid or doubtful.
a strong building or place that is protected against attack.

entries.ja: 人々が衝撃を受けることを気にせず、非常に公然と、衝撃的なやり方で行われること。
entries.ko: 사람들이 충격을 받든지 말든지 신경 쓰지 않고, 매우 공개적이고 충격적인 방식으로 행해지는.
entries.zh-Hans: 以一种非常公开和令人震惊的方式去做，毫不顾忌人们是否会感到震惊。
entries.es: Hecho de una manera muy abierta y chocante, sin importar si la gente se escandaliza.
entries.pt-BR: Feito de uma forma muito aberta e chocante, sem se importar se as pessoas ficam chocadas.

entries.ja: 誰かが物を盗むために建物に不法侵入する犯罪。
entries.ko: 누군가가 물건을 훔치기 위해 건물에 불법으로 침입하는 범죄.
entries.zh-Hans: 某人非法闯入建筑物盗窃物品的犯罪行为。
entries.es: Crímenes en los que alguien entra ilegalmente en un edificio para robar cosas.
entries.pt-BR: Crimes em que alguém entra ilegalmente em um edifício para roubar coisas.

entries.ja: 驚くほど大胆なリスクを負う意欲を示し、しばしば衝撃的または失礼な方法でそうすること。
entries.ko: 놀라울 정도로 대담한 위험을 감수하려는 의지를 보이며, 종종 충격적이거나 무례한 방식으로.
entries.zh-Hans: 表现出愿意承担出人意料的大胆风险，常常以令人震惊或粗鲁的方式。
entries.es: Que muestra una disposición a tomar riesgos sorprendentemente audaces, a menudo de una manera impactante o grosera.
entries.pt-BR: Que mostra uma disposição para correr riscos surpreendentemente audaciosos, muitas vezes de uma forma chocante ou rude.

entries.ja: 何かにひどく驚いたり衝撃を受けたりすること。
entries.ko: 어떤 일에 극도로 놀라거나 충격을 받은.
entries.zh-Hans: 对某事感到极其惊讶或震惊。
entries.es: Extremadamente sorprendido o conmocionado por algo.
entries.pt-BR: Extremamente surpreso ou chocado com algo.

entries.ja: 失われたり盗まれたりした後に再び見つけられること。
entries.zh-Hans: 丢失或被盗后又被找回。
entries.es: Encontrado de nuevo después de haberse perdido o robado.
entries.pt-BR: Encontrado novamente depois de ter sido perdido ou roubado.

entries.ja: 簡単に傷つけられたり、攻撃されたり、損害を受けたりしやすいこと。
entries.ko: 쉽게 다치거나 공격받거나 손상될 수 있는.
entries.zh-Hans: 容易受伤、被攻击或受损的。

entries.ja: 特定の行動のために選ばれたり、狙われたりすること。
entries.ko: 특정 행동을 위해 선택되거나 목표로 삼아진.
entries.zh-Hans: 被选中或被瞄准用于特定行动。
entries.es: Elegido o al que se apunta para una acción particular.
entries.pt-BR: Escolhido ou visado para uma ação específica.

entries.ja: 法律や規則によって許されていない、違法なこと。
entries.ko: 법률이나 규칙에 의해 허용되지 않는, 불법적인.
entries.zh-Hans: 不被法律或规则允许的；非法的。
entries.es: No permitido por las leyes o reglas; ilegal.
entries.pt-BR: Não permitido por leis ou regras; ilegal.

entries.ja: 特に、怖がらせたり疑わせたりすることで、誰かに何かをしないと決めさせること。
entries.ko: 특히 두려움을 느끼게 하거나 의심하게 함으로써, 누군가가 어떤 일을 하지 않기로 결정하게 만드는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 让某人决定不做某事，特别是通过让他们感到害怕或怀疑。
entries.es: Hacer que alguien decida no hacer algo, especialmente haciéndole sentir miedo o duda.
entries.pt-BR: Fazer com que alguém decida não fazer algo, especialmente fazendo-o sentir medo ou dúvida.

entries.ja: 攻撃から守られている頑丈な建物や場所。
entries.zh-Hans: 一个坚固的建筑物或地方，受到保护以抵御攻击。
entries.es: Un edificio o lugar fuerte que está protegido contra ataques.
entries.pt-BR: Um edifício ou lugar forte que é protegido contra ataques.
